title: [3.0-beta6] EROS pod change - pod not properly disabled?
symptom: During an Eros to Eros pod change, after deactivating the old pod, AAPS does not realize it is deactivated. Every minute, the Pod history displays 'set false temp basal because pod is suspended'. A notification 'data is coming from different pump' appears once. The Discard pod button appears but pressing it does nothing except adding a message. This occurs on beta 4-6 and persists in beta9.
cause: The thread does not explicitly state the root cause, but it is implied that AAPS fails to recognize the pod deactivation, leading to repeated fake temp basal messages. The issue is acknowledged as fixed in dev and will be in beta10.
fix: The fix is stated by MilosKozak: 'this is fixed in dev and will be in beta10'. No specific configuration change is given.
evidence_quote: this is fixed in dev and will be in beta10
